shellCommands.command: cat package.json && git diff package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json

cat app/page.tsx tsconfig.json; grep -n "refresh" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/web/exports/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "refresh()" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
ID=$(node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('.next/server/server-reference-manifest.json','utf8'));console.log(Object.keys(m.node)[0])")
echo "action id: $ID"
curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Notifications are [a-z]*'
curl -s -X POST localhost:3123/ -H "Next-Action: $ID" -H 'Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8' -d '[]' -o /dev/null -w "POST status %{http_code}\n" -D - | grep -iE '^(location|x-action-revalidated)' 
curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Notifications are [a-z]*'
pkill -f "next start" ; true

(npx next start -p 3124 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
ID=00ae4e23ab4a093d04b9b5e37766250a56796ebe1a
show() { curl -s localhost:3124/ | grep -oE 'Notifications are (<!-- -->)?[a-z]+' | sed 's/<!-- -->//'; }
show
curl -s -X POST localhost:3124/ -H "Next-Action: $ID" -H 'Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8' -d '[]' -o /dev/null -D - | grep -iE '^(HTTP|location|x-action-revalidated)'
show
curl -s -X POST localhost:3124/ -H "Next-Action: $ID" -H 'Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8' -d '[]' -o /dev/null
show
pkill -f "next start"; true
